book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Dee wei bouk loxyus e na tip lek o
Yesu la veil xomek vambuing on me la eno e xe xel betiyeing la wou e. En xel embei talex xomek nimzamza wei toungale is xomek vambuing o wou e.
Moxo neil, “Xam ghe wei lulti beimambei ne? A neil wou xam zonghek bei, tyek xel se teyei bei bong qakous nge mendei lek nge, qe tyek xel banex dalus deteina.”

Ka Yesu toundei lek lukendu Oliv, xel betiyeing venaxow lam wou e me teling. “Neil wou xa, gyeik inya tyek tine belup, me dee vati tyek nam a tax en ingwei wa being nam o me ingwei bouk na tip lek o?”
Yesu lewexe, “Xam ghe gweiteyei xow en kandek xelti se nam a tyoxe xam.
En tyek xel ngenong nam lek a leing, me na neimbei, ‘A Kilisi yo,’ me na tyoxe xomaxoneing ngenong.
Tyek xam a ngo vevek me qayeeng laweeng wei vevek o, ekom xam seng gwaleeng. Lulti beimambei ne tyek neing atyip, ekom bouk loxyus eno se ghei lam.
Tembuing nge tyek qandi me bo vevek is tembuing nge, me tete lalei nge tyek bo vevek is tete lalei nge. Inyon tyek maxep ngandoung me tyek tembuing api nanghei beyeeng danghei danghei nei.
Lul dalus ne inye myavanei nambei myaxeeng wei yak mi umbek o.
“Woyom tyek xel a zeimaxoun xam me bo nol wou xam de nyeis xam amey, me tembuing sapa tyek laleind bo nol wou xam en ay.
Lek bouk kayon xel ngenong tyek na toung demind wou xel xe wongeingis de tyek xel a dax ama vun me laleind bo nol wou ma,
me poropet tyonyeing ngenong tyek nam a tyip me na tyoxe xomaxoneing ngenong.
En kwa nilul on tyek bo ngandoung, de xel ngenong tyek na saing kwa wei lalei vineing o,
ekom eti yeiw wei nale nikanzek me ena bouk loxyus eno tyek Anutu devind xel veil meyeing.
De Xoulek Nimza tine en tete lalei eno tyek xel a neil e na eivek tembuing dalus en tembuing sapa na ngo, de woyom bouk loxyus eno tyek nam.

“Deka xam ghe gwei lul nilul ayang, wei mi wo nol wou lulul eno bale eivek beyeeng vambuing on nambei poropet Daniel neil en o.” Daniel 9:27 (Yon xam wei ghe mi pyaw qayeeng ne eno xam woulek e wo nimza.)
“Woyom eti yeiw wei mindei eivek Yudia eno xel a pek me na lek lukendu.
De wangwei tambiy ti toumendei lek xomek demi qetyei eno tyek se detei nox a qou lul valu eivek beeng lalei.
De tambiy ti toumendei eivek xuk eno se teyei bei nox me na qou e xe teimb ding nge.
Inyon tyek bo nilul ayang lek bouk tiyon en xel vex wei xeipouyek o me tayeiw wei di wo luul wou neu yo!
Xam a zeimemamim enok bouk wei pekeing eno qandi lek bouk wei nityuweing o lek bouk wei Sabat o.

En lek bouk tiyon nimaying ngandoung tyek nam. Myaxeeng wei tembuing qandi vako yo me elam tyip gweimbeeng ne, eno nimaying ambei nyon se lam tulek xomaxoneing, de loxyus eno nimaying ambei nye tyek se nox atyip no.
Wangwei Anutu se qateiv bouk tiyon bo sepi, yond tyek qetya xomaxoneing on veil, ekom wounalei en moux alis vex wei beyal om qateiv bouk wo sepi.
Lek bouk kayon eno wangwei xelti na neil wou wang bei, ‘Wei, Kilisi inye!’ o, ‘Moxo inyei!’ ond wang seng bongis qayeeng on.
En xomaxoneing tyonyeing valu tyek na neimbei a Kilisi o a poropet ti. Me tyek xel nam a tyip me bong dee me lulvako, wangwei xel teyei nei on tyek xel a tyoxe xomaxoneing wei Anutu beyal o.
Wei, a neil wou xam a tax en lul dalus tine wei tyek nam atyip o.
“Om wangwei xelti e neil wou xam, ‘Wei, moxo toundei eivek tembuing bandaing nei,’ yon xam seng na inyei, o ‘Moxo inye, toundei eivek xomek lalei nei,’ ond xam seng bongis.
En nambei kawei zivip mi nex mema lam anghei ninei is xeiyaing me byex la lek tembuing tambak nei me la xeinei, om tyek bong ambei nyon lek bouk wei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux embei noum o.
Lek beyeeng wei meyeing mi yeip lek o, inyon xel tuw mi qeku lak inyon.
“Ka nimaying sapa tine na ma veil le, woyom lutika eno

content.text: de dentouk tyek se teyeimbei tel, me
betum tyek detei nanghei tyoung nei,
de tyoung dalus tyek bo pimapi.’ Yesaya 13:10; 34:4

content: “Lek bouk kayon dee wei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux tyek nam mendei yaingateiv eivek tyoung, me xel veleivlei dalus wei tembuing eno tyek deeng. De tyek xel gyei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux mendi nam lek laxap, is nikanzek me xeiyaing ngandoung.
Me moxo tyek bong e xe angelayeiw na is vukxax wei wo vya xoulekeing, me tyek xel qekuwou e xe xomaxoneing wei beyal o eivek tembuing sapa me ena tembuing myasepu dalus.
“Woyom xam a qou kwa wou xax basunghek. Gyeik xam ghe gwei bei xax mema wo nilouk me lis vako byex lek, xam ghe boulek bei bouk wei seiv embei siing eno lam paviy.
Nambei nyon om gyeik xam ghe gwei lul dalus ti beimambei ne, xam ghe boulek bei Xomaxoneing Neu lam paviy me toungale wou qapomb.
A neil wou xam zonghek bei, xel moux alis vex ti gweimbeeng ne tyek se mey qe ka lulti beimambei ne neing atyip le.
Tyoung gheyapu me tembuing tyek nati, ekom a xe qayeeng tyek se teyei bei nati.
Bouk me seivma wei xelti se woulek
“Xelti se woulek bouk o seivma wei Kilisi embei noum o, xel angela eivek tyoung gheyapu, o Neu moux se woulek, qe Ma venaxow.
Nambei ingwei eivek bouk wei Noaka yo, om tyek xel bong ambei kayon eivek bouk wei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux embei noum o.
Myaxeeng lek bouk wei memiing se ghei butek o, xomaxoneing mi ya me num, me iima, me iima lox me loum, me la tyip wou bouk wei Noaka la eivek sip o.
Xel se woulek vati wei embei belup wou xel o dekakom memiing butek me qou xel dalus me la. Kwa kayon eno tyek bong ambei nyon lek bouk wei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux noum o.
Moux yayuw toundei eivek xuk yaeing eno tyek Anutu na qou nge na veil de nge na toumendei.
Vex yayuw tyek mendi zouk wit, de tyek Anutu na qou nge de nge na toumendei.
“Nambei nyon xam ghe gweiteyei xow, en nambei xam seng woulek bouk vati wei xam xe Tambiy Ngandoung tyek nam o.
Ekom xam ghe bou naleimim bei, wangwei xomek ma boulek seivma vati wei xel panaxeing embei nam o, moxo tyek mendei bin e xe xomek en kandek xelti se dembu me na eivek.
Om xam is ambei nyon xam ghe gweiwou xow, en Xomaxoneing Neu Moux tyek nam lek seivma wei xam seng woulek bei tyek nam o.
“Woyom xukxe eti ingwei lupeyei nimza wei mi yeiteyei e xe xuk wo nimza nei? Wei e xe teiv toung e yeiteyei xel xukxe eivek e beeng bei e mi bong yaeing wou xel lek bouk wei teiv beyal o bombek?
Inyon nimza wou xukxe tiyon wei e xe teiv yei bei moxo mi wong xuk on gyeik e loum o.
A neil wou xam zonghek bei, teiv tyek na toung embo lei ngandoung en lul dalus eivek e beeng.
Ekom wangwei xukxe tiyon tambiy nilul ti om mi neil wou xow, ‘A xe teiv la toundei dingta takwei nei,’
woyom moxo la me leis e xe xel wei xel xouing mi wo xuk lekti yo, de mi ya me num is xel wei mi num me wo nol o.
Teiv wei xukxe tiyon tyek noum lek bouk wei xukxe se woulek me seivma wei se woulek o.
Teiv tyek bo myaveweeng ngandoung wou e me na toung e na is xel wei myend yuw o, nanghei inyon eno tyek xel deeng me xel newound bo nyiknyik.
